chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'a from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Hammad Dhi al-Nab from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): In

a man who died and left two daughters and his father, he said: 'For the father is one-sixth and for the two daughters is the remainder.' He said: 'And if he left daughters and sons, the father would not be diminished from the one-sixth by anything.' I said to him: 'For he left daughters and sons and a mother.' He said: 'For the mother is one-sixth and the remainder is divided among them, 'for the male is like the portion of the two females'.'

key_terms.لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ اَلْأُنْثَيَيْنِ: for the male is like the portion of the two females

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a father when his son leaves behind daughters and a mother?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific application of the 'father as residuary' rule, noting that his fixed one-sixth share is not reduced even when sons are present, distinguishing his status from other male heirs. It further establishes the mother's entitlement to one-sixth in the presence of children, aligning with the general principles of *Fara'id*. The narration highlights the precise distribution mechanics where the father's fixed portion is secured before the residual estate is allocated to the children according to the standard male-to-female two-to-one ratio.
